newsitem.title: UK: Standard off on Cazenove comments.
newsitem.headline: Standard off on Cazenove comments.

text.p: Shares in Standard Chartered fell 20p to 691-1/2p by 0801 GMT after brokerage Cazenove told its clients that the bank's growth seems to be slowing, traders said on Tuesday.
The brokerage declined to comment, but traders said Cazenove turned cautious on the shares.
While Standard Chartered shares were not downgraded, traders said Cazenove analysts were forecasting slower growth after having met with Standard Chartered executives, traders said.
"There's no outright sell (recommendation), but (Cazenove) is saying the days of strong growth are coming to an end ... they're not going to be outperforming as they have been," said one trader.
